Schedule Of Submission/ Maintenance: Permission to be obtained with relevant documents before construction, reconstruction or extension.
Registration/license to be obtained before commencement of manufacturing process for the first time and application to be submitted on or before October 31st of every year for renewal.
The notice of change of manager shall be in Form 3-A.
The registration and license shall be obtained from the concerned authority.
Period of overtime work shall be entered in Form 10.
The Register of adult workers shall be in Form 12.
The manager shall keep an up-to-date Register in Form 15 for leave
Within 12 hours for death or dangerous occurrence and within 24 hours of the expiry of 48 hours of the accident (bodily injury), the factory manager shall send the report to the concerned authority.
Medical examination of workers to be conducted annually
Annual return to be submitted by 31st March every year
